from flask import Flask, request app = Flask(__name__) @app.route('/policies') def policies(): tax = request.args.get('tax') minimum_wage = request.args.get('minimum_wage') html_ = '''

Tax Policy

Tax is {} %.

Minimum Wage

The minimum wage is {} dollars an hour.

'''.format(tax, minimum_wage) return html_
